task.description:
Run the OIDC-09 integration tests and produce a structured test report.

Commands to run:
1. zig build (must exit 0)
2. zig build test (must exit 0) — unit tests
3. zig build test-integration-oidc09 (must exit 0) — integration tests against real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL

Write the test report to tests/reports/report-WF02-oidc09-20260527-step04.json with:
- All test names and pass/fail status
- Any issues found with severity classification (BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR)
- Execution times

IMPORTANT: No mocks, no stubs. Integration tests MUST connect to real PostgreSQL.
